## A Few Highlights Worth Noting

**Despacito** (2017) sits comfortably at #1 with over 9 billion views, making it the most-watched music video of all time and the most dominant pop release of this entire era. It was also a cross-genre phenomenon blending Latin pop and reggaeton, which explains its extraordinary global reach.[2]

**2014 was arguably the peak year** for this list, contributing Uptown Funk, Thinking Out Loud, Blank Space, Shake It Off, and Bailando — five songs in the top 20 alone. Ed Sheeran also dominates with three entries (Shape of You, Perfect, Thinking Out Loud), making him the most-represented solo artist in the ranking.[1][2]

**PSY's Gangnam Style** (2012) holds a legendary place in YouTube history — it was the first video ever to reach 1 billion views, and briefly held the all-time record before Despacito overtook it. The list also reflects how 2010 opened the decade strongly with Waka Waka (Shakira's FIFA World Cup anthem) and Justin Bieber's Baby, both still pulling billions of views today.[2][1]
